title: Rightward zone cascade
statement: For a zone configuration and a natural number $j$, the rightward cascade applies the zone-step operation at indices $j,j-1,\ldots,1$ in that order, performs a rightward zone move, and then applies the zone-step operation at indices $1,2,\ldots,j$ in that order. When $j=0$, both sequences of zone steps are empty.
caveat: The precise effects of the zone-step and zone-move operations depend on helper definitions that are not included.
